narrative:
Fulton County has 28,852 registered voters, with 17.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.6%, a clear Democratic lean of 9.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.2% of registrants.
